discovery: Controlled/living radical polymerization, especially atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP), for precise synthesis of well-defined polymers
rationale: Recent Chemistry prizes (2022 click chemistry, 2023 quantum dots, 2024 protein design, 2025 MOFs) have favored foundational synthetic methods with wide practical use. ATRP and related controlled radical polymerization changed polymer and materials chemistry, with extremely high citation impact and industrial uptake in coatings, adhesives, biomaterials and electronics. Matyjaszewski and Sawamoto independently reported metal-catalyzed living radical polymerization in 1995 and appear on many shortlists. Polymer chemistry has not won since 2000, which leaves room for a macromolecular award.
